card: Fixes compact block relay during assumeutxo background validation by excluding historical blocks in flight when deciding whether to request new tip blocks as compact blocks. Currently, historical block downloads inflate mapBlocksInFlight, causing snapshot nodes to fall back to requesting full blocks for new tip blocks and preventing high-bandwidth compact block peer configuration. No external dependencies are noted.
evidence: PR description and commit: 'While background validation runs after loading an assumeutxo snapshot, blocks needed only by the background (historical) chainstate are also tracked in mapBlocksInFlight. The condition that decides whether a new block is requested as a compact block counted those blocks as well, so with historical blocks in flight the new block at the tip was requested as a full block instead.'
problem: After loading an assumeutxo snapshot, background validation downloads historical blocks that populate mapBlocksInFlight. Because net_processing counts all in-flight blocks indiscriminately, having any historical blocks in flight causes the node to fail the in-flight checks in HeadersDirectFetchBlocks and BlockChecked, forcing it to fetch new tip blocks as full blocks instead of compact blocks.

risk.why: A flaw in historical block identification or in-flight counting could disrupt block download state machine checks or compact block request logic.

summary: Excludes historical blocks needed only by the assumeutxo background chainstate when checking how many blocks are in flight. This allows nodes validating background chainstate after loading an assumeutxo snapshot to continue requesting newly announced tip blocks via compact blocks and setting peers as high-bandwidth compact block announcers. Functional test coverage is added to feature_assumeutxo.py.
